blockquote.p: "Welcome to ACH Unified School District. Our commitment extends beyond traditional education; we cultivate analytical thinking, civic responsibility, and lifelong learning for every child in our community."

"As we advance our Strategic Plan, we continue investing in modern laboratory facilities, expanding AP and Career Technical Pathways, and ensuring that every school maintains high safety and support standards."
